action.objective: Complete broad-search coverage of all legal moves at depth 4 before selecting a candidate.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search; candidate_moves must be empty. The position is a Scotch-like structure where Black has played e5 and d5, and White already developed Nc3 and Nf3. Full root coverage will identify captures like Nxd5/Nxe5, healthy central/développement moves like e4, d4, b3, g3, and quiet developing moves, at shared depth 4 using half the node budget.
